Earthfall - Last Signal

The final moments of Earth.

Through Iris’s eyes, this story follows the collapse of humanity, the silence after the screams, and the last signal sent from a dying world.

Earth has fallen.

But its ending is not finished yet.

I poured a lot of energy into this one, and I truly hope you’ll enjoy it.
Thank you for your support, and for following my stories.
